description: Card illustrations for the game. For each entry in `cards`, generate one image from `prompt` and save it as `output`. Do not change the style between cards.
styleBlock:
Illustration for a card in a small browser game called "One More Building": a turn-based zombie survival deckbuilder set in a quiet, grey, abandoned European town.

FORMAT: Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 px, PNG. Full-bleed illustration with its own background (no transparency, no border, no frame). ONE clear subject, centred, filling about 60% of the image, with at least 10% calm margin on every side (the game crops the image to a wide strip). It must read clearly when shrunk to 200 px wide: bold silhouette, simple shapes, strong contrast.

STYLE: Flat-shaded graphic illustration with a slightly rough, hand-inked outline, like a modern screen-printed poster or gritty graphic novel. NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT cute, NOT anime. Muted desaturated palette: concrete greys and off-white, dark charcoal outlines, plus at most ONE accent colour (hazard amber #b87800, danger red #a5312a or safe teal #2a7462; the accent for this card is given below). Simple background: a soft flat colour field or a faint hint of wall, floor or street; no detailed scenery, no crowds. Light paper grain or halftone texture is fine. Mood: tense, quiet, resourceful. Not gory: no blood splatter and no violence shown on a person. Zombies, if present, are dark silhouettes only.

STRICT RULES: NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures or UI. No close-up human faces (hands and silhouettes are fine). Do not copy any existing franchise, character, brand or card game artwork. Keep the style identical across all cards.
